title: Shopping-Relationship Multiplier on Late Delivery Claims Goodwill
content:
Claims Review Board ruling for Delivery Claims: the late-delivery make-good on a Late Delivery Claim reflects the customer's shopping over the past year.

**Ruling.** The shopping-relationship multiplier depends on the customer's orders in the trailing 12 calendar months: merchandise booked on them totalling 400.00 USD or more together with at least 3 orders placed multiplies the make-good by 1.25; merchandise of 400.00 USD or more on fewer than 3 orders multiplies it by 1.10; any other customer keeps the make-good as it is.

## What is measured

- Merchandise booked: the booked amounts of the booking lines on the customer's orders in the 12 calendar months up to today.
- Orders placed: the customer's orders whose placed date falls in those 12 calendar months, the late order among them when it was placed in that window.

## Combinations

| Merchandise booked in the trailing 12 months | Orders placed in that window | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 400.00 USD or more | 3 or more | 1.25 |
| 400.00 USD or more | fewer than 3 | 1.10 |
| below 400.00 USD | any number | 1 — the make-good as it is |

## Edge cases (hypothetical customers)

- 400.00 USD booked across 3 orders: both thresholds are met exactly — 1.25.
- 400.00 USD booked across 2 orders: spend met, order count not — 1.10.
- 399.99 USD booked across 6 orders: spend not met — the make-good as it is.
- A make-good sum of 20.00 USD for a customer at 1.25 becomes 25.00 USD on this multiplier; at 1.10 it becomes 22.00 USD.
